verdict.rationale: The use-cases doc lists "Financial insights for agents", covering agent-powered spending analysis and balance and transaction monitoring via the Link CLI. This suggests AI-driven insights are possible, but they are produced by external agents consuming the data rather than generated inside the product. The Stripe MCP server only lets agents call the API and search docs, so it does not provide in-product insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions, documentation of what insights are produced and how they are surfaced, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
